note: Hard red-flag floor for triage. Keywords and text are normalised the same way (lowercase, accents and Arabic hamza/harakat stripped, ى->ي, ة->ه, Arabic-Indic digits -> ASCII). A string keyword matches whole tokens (a trailing "*" marks a stem, e.g. "suicid*"; Arabic keywords also match with their attached proclitics و ف ب ل ك ال and pronoun suffixes); {"all": [...]} needs every term somewhere; {"regex": ...} runs on the normalised text, where <<word>> stands for a whole Arabic token with its proclitics and suffixes; a term {"context": "elderly"} holds for age 75+ or an elderly clue in the text; "affirm": true keeps a keyword valid inside a negation ("no pulse", "can't breathe"). A hit that starts on a negated noun phrase, or that sits next to a past-history marker ("AVC en 2019", "history of"), is ignored (see triage.py). Flags marked provisional are illustrative and must be confirmed by the hospital's doctors. Errs towards raising urgency. Not clinically validated.

flags.note: No pulse, not breathing, unresponsive, cardiac arrest. Every keyword is affirm: these phrasings carry a negation word that is the emergency itself.
